scope: Read-only firmware analysis recorded for a future compact UI; no implementation or device changes.

hardware_validation.note: The existing v1 page used style RAM0x200d68fc on hardware. Its configured size is established offline by initialization code; the smaller styles and factory calls have not been tested by this project on the band.

predefined_styles.proof: style_init at bfca; r2=0 at bfce; r1=40 at bfd0; r0=1 at bfd2; font factory call at bfd4; style font setter at bfdc; literal0x2c44c16c points to style

miwear_font_create.signature: const void *(*)(unsigned family_index, unsigned size, unsigned flags)
miwear_font_create.proof: Checks index<=9, resolves name via0x2c9ef654, passes existing r1/r2 to vg_font_create at0x2c780248. Native style initialization passes flags=0.

vg_font_create.signature: const void *(*)(const char *family, unsigned size, unsigned flags)
vg_font_create.proof: r0=name, r1=size, r2=flags. Creates descriptor {name pointer at+0, uint16 size at+4, uint16 flags at+6}; font manager cache viaRAM0x200ccd74. Diagnostic literal0x2ca73c28 names function vg_font_create.
vg_font_create.caveat: Flags are not the Lua Font weight parameter. Do not pass 400 just because Lua uses normal weight 400.

lv_style_init.proof: Every verified font-style initialization calls it before setting the font. Predefined style slots are12 bytes apart. A future own style requires explicit ABI/lifetime validation.

lv_style_set_text_font.proof: Native font-style initializers pass factory result inr1 and style address inr0.

lvx_obj_set_style_text.signature: void (*)(void *object, void *style, unsigned opacity, unsigned selector)
lvx_obj_set_style_text.proof: Existing project binding. Removes/adds baseline style0x200d6668 and supplied style, then sets opacity. It does not take a font size directly.

fallback.proof: miwear_font_create returns this when underlying factory givesNULL; Lua Font special-cases its built-in default14px using same pointer.
fallback.future_requirement: A successful non-null pointer alone does not prove the requested size was created. Detect fallback/error before promising exact typography.

next_implementation_constraints: User requested visualization first; no compact UI implementation or installation is authorized by this evidence record.
Keep frozen v1/v2 sources and ELF files unchanged.
Prefer existing 22/20/17 styles for an initial compact implementation if accepted; exact16/18 require new guarded bindings and device acceptance.
Configured font size is not the final rendered line height; use native text metrics or content-derived layout rather than guessed fixed text heights.
Any newly created style/font must stay valid for as long as live labels reference it. Do not mutate shared firmware styles.
reference_scope: Primary repository identifies the existing style RAM addresses and lvx_obj_set_style_text binding. Sizes, family table, initialization sites and candidate factory ABI above are derived from the exact local firmware, not claimed as repository documentation.
